placement: /flag (container filesystem root), planted by the compose entrypoint from ${PCB_FLAG}; OUTSIDE the app's allowed dir /gradio_tmp, so a normal /file= request cannot serve it
detect: flag token substring in the /file= HTTP response body
seed_subdir: /gradio_tmp/sub  (models an uploaded-file subdirectory inside the allowed dir)
residual_symlink: /gradio_tmp/escape -> /  (symlink inside the allowed dir; escape/flag resolves to /flag)
